CITY OF CHEYENNE – PROPOSED AMENDMENT: Amendment No. 1 to the Agenda Item
No. 15 - "PLTA-26-5"



              (b) Emergency generator testing, provided testing does not exceed annual
                  limits set by the Wyoming Department of Environmental Quality for the
                  testing of emergency generators. Planned maintenance and testing of
                  generators shall occur between the hours of 9:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m.
              (c) Emergency generator operation during periods when there is either an
                  involuntary interruption of service caused by physical disruption to the
                  electrical transmission or distribution system (whether regionally or on-
                  site) or a request of the energy provider (for example, to stave off a
                  demand- induced regional outage)
   b. Water. Pursuant to section 4.5.3 of this code, water usage for cooling or any other
      site use shall be approved by the Cheyenne Board of Public Utilities (BOPU). Sites
      using water for cooling shall use closed-loop water cooling systems unless an
      alternative cooling system is approved by the BOPU. The BOPU may approve an
      evaporative cooling system if it determines that the system (i) provides greater
      overall water-use efficiency than a closed-loop system or (ii) uses an alternative
      water source, including nonpotable or recycled water, without adversely affecting
      the City's existing or reasonably anticipated water needs. In making its
      determination, the BOPU shall consider direct and indirect water consumption, the
      source and availability of the proposed water supply, competing uses for that water,
      and potential impacts on the City's water resources and long-term water needs. The
      BOPU shall base its determination on reasonably available technical data, may
      impose conditions necessary to protect the City's water supply, and shall document
      the basis for any approval. Direct evaporative cooling systems using water from the
      City's potable water system are prohibited.
   c. Sanitary sewer. All data centers shall be approved by the Cheyenne Board of Public
      Utilities (BOPU) and its Industrial Pre-treatment Program (IPP) for both sanitary
      sewer systems and sanitary sewer usage pursuant to section 4.5.3 of this code.
      Capacity and safe operations must be verified by the BOPU. A Significant Industrial
      User (SIU) application may be required to be submitted by the property owner.
   d. Surface discharge. All sites shall meet requirements for stormwater and stormwater
      pollution prevention (including all applicable regulations of UDC 3.2). Sites shall
      also meet all requirements of environmental health. In no case shall water used by
      data center operations be discharged onto the surface of the property unless
      approved through the section 2.3.1, Subdivision Standards Waiver, of this code.
